caseName: United States v. Montgomery Ward & Co.
caseNameFull: United States v. Montgomery Ward & Co., Inc.
attorneys: Solicitor General Fahy for the United States., Messrs. Stuart S. Ball, John A. Barr, Harold A. Smith, Guy A. Gladson and Arthur D. Welton for respondents.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certi-orari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit denied for the reason that application has been made prior to judgment of the Circuit Court of Appeals.
